long.description:
Which animal kills the most people? Not the shark. Meatball ranks the deadliest animals on Earth by how many people they actually kill: sharks (about nine a year), the kissing bug that bites your face while you sleep, the dog (rabies), the snake that warns you by sizzling, and the tiny winner that kills more than half a million people a year.

Which animal kills the most people? 🐍 snake / 🐕 dog / 🦟 something tiny. Comment your guess before the end 👇
